The '''Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Cruiser''', also referred to as the '''Imperial ''Gozanti''-class TIE carrier''' and known generally as the '''Imperial freighter''', was a converted and heavily modified model of the standard civilian [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]] and later by sympathizers of the [[First Order]].

==Characteristics==
The Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Cruiser was a nearly 64-[[meter]]-long [[starship]] that<ref name="Rebels Guide" /> served as a [[light cruiser]].<ref name="HC 20" /> It was a modification of the civilian [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] that was utilised by many factions.<ref name="TIE Manual" />

[[File:GozantiEngines-Kanan5.png|thumb|left|200px|The engines of an Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]]
It sported a twin [[laser turret]] in a dorsal mount and a heavy [[laser cannon]] on its ventral side. The ''Gozanti'' also had a loading elevator on the bottom near the nose and docking ports to the side near the cockpit section. The ships had a [[hyperdrive]] and three engines.<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy" />

The standard-conversion<ref name="TIE Manual" />  [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] model could carry either, four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s,<ref name="Rebels Guide" /> (or have one starfighter swapped for a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bomber]]),<ref name="Iron Squadron">{{Rebels|Iron Squadron (episode)}}</ref> two [[All Terrain Defense Pod]]s<ref name="Droids">{{Rebels|Droids in Distress}}</ref> on underside-mounted docking clamps which were connected to corridors inside the vessel.<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy" /><ref name="Droids" /> The Imperial ships were wider than standard ones, with new side extensions stretching over the engines, and the dorsal radar dish moved to the center. The large, ventral, double dish radar of the civilian version was abandoned in favor of docking struts to ferry the starship's complement.<ref name="Rebels Guide" />

Some particular Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruisers, such as the ''[[Vector]]'', featured red livery.<ref name="FFGXW">{{FFGXW|set=Imperial Assault Carrier Expansion Pack|cardname=''Vector''}}</ref> The [[Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]]<ref name="Gozanti Armada">{{Armada|set=Imperial Assault Carriers Expansion Pack}}</ref> was an alternate configuration and variant of the standard Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser.<ref name="TIE Manual" />  Another variant was the [[Imperial scan cruiser]], utilised for scanning operations and equipped with extra [[radar]] dishes to do so.<ref name="One Year Later">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref>

==History==
===Imperial cruisers===
[[File:BloodCrowTIEs-Thrawn2.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Blood Crow'' was a ''Gozanti''-class cruiser in the early days of the Empire.]]
[[18 BBY|1 year]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise of the Empire]], an [[Unidentified Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser (Balmorra)|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] under the command of [[Captain]] [[Pearce]] transported [[Howzer]] and 2 of his men from [[Balmorra]] to [[Tantiss Base]] on [[Wayland]], but was intercepted by the [[Clone Underground]], who defeated its crew of 12 [[TK stormtrooper]]s and an [[Imperial royal guard]] to free them. When under interrogation, however, Pearce used a [[electro capsule]] to kill himself, while a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer]] sent several [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]] to destroy any trace of it, though the group was able to flee. Several years later, the freighters were converted into [[TIE series|TIE]] carriers<ref name="Dawn">[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']]</ref> using the quartet of ventral-mounted heavy docking clamps. The clamps also doubled as boarding chutes between the transport and any vehicle they carried.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> Imperial efficiency expert [[Count]] [[Denetrius Vidian]] was instrumental in the [[development program]], getting it ready ahead of schedule.<ref name="Bottleneck">{{StoryCite|story=Bottleneck (short story)|book=The Rise of the Empire}}</ref> Several ''Gozanti''-class cruisers were present at Count Vidian's [[Calcoraan Depot]], and were ordered to protect a [[Baradium-357]] convoy at [[Gorse]].<ref name="Dawn" />

During the reign of the Empire, the cruisers were also known as the Imperial freighters and were more common in the Outer Rim despite its use by the Empire.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> After graduating from the [[Royal Imperial Academy]], [[Lieutenant]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and [[Ensign]] [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]] were stationed aboard the ''[[Blood Crow]]'', an Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser under the command of [[Rik Virgilio]].<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> a group of rebels known as the [[Spectres]] raided [[Transport 651]] in order to [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|rescue]] a group of [[Wookiee]] [[Slavery|slaves]], but it was a trap set by [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]]. The rebels detonated explosives, destroying the freighter after it was secured in the hangar of the ''[[Lawbringer]]''.<ref name="Spark">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''</ref> Soon after, Kallus and a squad of [[stormtrooper]]s took a freighter to attack the same rebel cell after they stole a shipment of [[T-7 ion disruptor rifle]]s. The ship dropped two [[All Terrain Defense Pod|AT-DPs]], which were destroyed by the rebels.<ref name="Droids" />

[[File:GozantiATDP-SWRHoM.png|thumb|right|250px|A ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier carrying two AT-DPs]]
[[Standard week|Weeks]] later, a convoy of three cruisers was tasked with transporting a large [[kyber crystal]]. The same Lothal rebel cell captured an Imperial [[decoder]] and [[Mission to destroy a kyber crystal|discovered]] the convoy's location. The starship ''[[Ghost]]'' arrived and launched its shuttle, piloted by former Jedi [[Kanan Jarrus]], to distract the convoy's TIE escorts. The lead freighter attempted to flee back into hyperspace, but was destroyed by the ''Ghost''. The kyber crystal amplified the explosion and destroyed the rest of the Imperial ships.<ref name="Breaking Ranks" />

In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> [[Evac One|Transport Ship 63378]] was stolen by the same rebel cell on Lothal. The cruiser was used in the [[action at Mustafar]], a rescue attempt by the Spectres to save Kanan, who had been captured by [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], and was being interrogated on his [[Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Sovereign]]'', in orbit above [[Mustafar]].<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy" /> The same year, several ''Gozanti'' freighters took part in the [[Blockade of Ibaar|Imperial blockade]] of [[Ibaar]]. They deployed starfighters against [[Phoenix Cell]] ships attempting to break the blockade.<ref name="Wings of the Master">{{Rebels|Wings of the Master}}</ref> At some point in that year, an Imperial scan cruiser was present on the planet [[Mina-Rau]] to assist with an [[Imperial Supply Census]] on the planet.<ref name="One Year Later" />

In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="A Princess on Lothal date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[A Princess on Lothal]]," including the appearance of Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruisers on [[Lothal]], to [[3 BBY]].</ref> a cruiser was used to deploy two [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT]] walkers to the [[Lothal Depot|Imperial depot]] on [[Lothal]].<ref name="APOL">{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}}</ref> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="2 BBY date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[The Last Battle]]," including the appearance of ''Gozanti''-class [[cruiser]]s on [[Agamar]], to [[2 BBY]].</ref> two ''Gozanti'' cruisers were used to deploy pairs of AT-AT and AT-DP walkers against a [[Separatist holdouts|Separatist holdout]] on [[Agamar]].<ref name="The Last Battle">{{Rebels|The Last Battle}}</ref> Imperial forces also lost two cruisers during a [[Skirmish over Mykapo|skirmish]] with the [[Iron Squadron]] and Phoenix Group above [[Mykapo]].<ref name="Iron Squadron" /> A ''Gozanti'' cruiser later accompanied an Imperial light cruiser during a failed attempt to capture the rogue [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]].<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref>

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="1 BBY Note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[A Fool's Hope]]," including the appearance of ''Gozanti''-class [[cruiser]]s in the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Republic)|Seventh Fleet]], to [[1 BBY]].</ref> at least two ''Gozanti'' cruisers were among a detachment of the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] blockading Lothal.<ref name="A Fool's Hope">{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}}</ref>

===Post-Scarif Galactic Civil War===
[[File:Gozanti-class_Cruiser_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier in orbit over Coruscant]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War]], [[smuggler]]s also used the cruisers.<ref name="Commander">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref> Following the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Imperial officer]]s [[Ciena Ree]] and [[Berisse Sai]] were ordered to take a ''Gozanti'' to recover [[Sith Lord|Lord]] Vader. Once they arrived at Yavin, they surveyed the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], and then [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced|Vader's]] [[TIE Advanced x1|starfighter]] docked with them. Vader ordered the two officers into the cargo bay, and piloted the ship himself back to the Imperial fleet.<ref name="Lost Stars">''[[Lost Stars]]''</ref>

While [[Mission to Akiva (Han Solo)|transporting]] [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi]] to [[Akiva]] in the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', the smugglers [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] encountered [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]. Wondering where the Imperial [[starfighter]]s had come from, Solo speculated that there must be a ''Gozanti''-class cruiser nearby.<ref name="SW35">[[Star Wars (2015) 35|''Star Wars'' (2015) 35]]</ref>

Captain [[Kosh]] of the Empire stockpiled several cruisers which had been listed as destroyed to use them in his black-market operation, although they were discovered by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] on Tatooine and [[Battle for Tatooine|destroyed]] by [[Saponza's partner]].<ref name="Commander" /><ref name="Starwars.com">[[Kekit]]'s Databank entry states that Saponza and his partner played an integral part in the campaign that liberated a Jawa clan from the Tusken Raiders. It also states that the plan was orchestrated by [[Jennica Pierce]] of the Rebel Alliance. This scenario does not occur if the player aligns with the Empire, so it can be deduced that Saponza's gang joined the Rebellion.</ref>

One of the freighters showed up during [[61st Mobile Infantry|Twilight Company's]] [[raid on an Imperial heavy freighter]], threatening the ''[[Thunderstrike]]''. The freighters were present alongside [[Death Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]], where they deployed [[walker]]s during the battle.<ref name="Twilight Company">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref>

===After the Empire===
[[File:FirstOrderSympathizer-HSCK.png|thumb|right|250px|The First Order utilized older Imperial-era ships for patrol and surveillance duties.]]
Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruisers remained in use during the [[Cold War]] on into the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. The [[First Order]] employed sympathizers that piloted these older Imperial-era ships in patrol and surveillance operations.<ref name="SWZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The young-readers book ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and featuring various match-ups from the series, placed an Imperial ''Gozanti'' cruiser against an [[Auzituck anti-slaver gunship|''Auzituck'' anti-slaver gunship]], with the gunship damaging the cruiser and escaping.<ref name="Head-to-Head">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]''</ref>
